d: Long, flowing silver-white hair with straight bangs and a soft texture frames a youthful, adolescent face with wide, pale lavender eyes. The slender build is dressed in a dark charcoal-grey double-breasted coat with a wide collar, paired with deep navy blue leggings and black heeled boots. A voluminous navy blue scarf covers the lower half of the face, complemented by a black headset with a microphone, black fingerless gloves, and a brown leather satchel containing blue flowers. One hand holds a black handheld radio.
